The '''Barsen'thor's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|green]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] that was created and wielded by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]]. After his death, the lightsaber was placed in the Barsen'thor's [[Chandrila Jedi tomb|tomb]].

==History==
The hilt of the [[First Blade]] was recovered by the [[The Barsen'thor|Barsen'thor]] at the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. This Jedi then mounted the hilt into a lightsaber, complete with a green [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] that had been found in the [[Vur Tepe|Tythonian Forge]]. [[Yuon Par]], the consular's Jedi master. While Fess stood guard, the consular deeply concentrated and used the machine to create a working lightsaber.<ref name="The Forge">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|The Forge|Tython}}</ref>
